Admin.title: Admin Panel
Admin.cloneText: Creates an independent copy - images, variants and all related data included. The saved version is copied, so unsaved changes on this form are not.
Admin.cloneError: Failed to clone. Please try again.
Admin.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
Admin.errorSave: Failed to save. Please try again.
Admin.errorDelete: Failed to delete. Please try again.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.heroVideoIntro: How your logo and text are laid out over the hero video - on the landing page and on every product, service or dish that has one.
Admin.heroLayoutDefaultHint: Logo and text centred over the video, logo above the text.
Admin.heroLayoutProfileHint: Logo in a circle straddling the bottom edge of the video - half in, half out, like a profile picture on a cover photo - with the text centred above it.
Admin.heroTextFrameHint: Wrap the page or section heading over a hero in an outline frame - with your brandmark in a circle on top when you've uploaded one. Applies to category, highlight and product/service/dish pages; the landing hero is left as it is.
Admin.typographyIntro: Your site's typefaces, loaded from Google Fonts. One stylesheet URL can carry both families; the two name fields say which is used for headings and which for body text. Leave all three blank to keep the default font.
Admin.typographyPreviewBody: And this is how a paragraph of body text will read on your site, at the size visitors actually see it.
Admin.googleFontUrlHelp: Copy the stylesheet URL from fonts.google.com, e.g. https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces&family=Karla&display=swap
Admin.googleFontUrlInvalid: Must be an https link on fonts.googleapis.com
Admin.watermarkIntro: Tile your logo faintly behind every page, and choose the page background it sits on. Admin pages are never watermarked.
Admin.watermarkPreviewBody: Body text sits on top of the pattern. Keep the watermark faint enough that this stays comfortable to read.
Admin.watermarkPreviewThemeHint: Switch the theme to preview the other background.
Admin.welcomeSubtitle: Manage your website content from this panel.
Admin.systemDesc: Configure site settings, branding, colors and content.
Admin.productsDesc: Create, edit and manage your product catalog.
Admin.servicesDesc: Add and manage the services you offer.
Admin.highlightsDesc: Feature important highlights on the homepage.
Admin.enhanceModelText: The first time you use the Enhance feature, the AI model (~350 MB) is downloaded once to your browser. This may take a minute. Continue?
Admin.enhanceOptionsText: Select the output structure for the generated text.
Admin.logoAssetsModalText: Would you like to automatically generate the favicon and manifest icons (1080×, 512×, 256×, 192×, 128×) from the uploaded logo?
Admin.errorGenerateAssets: Failed to generate assets from logo.
Admin.stripeKeySet: Saved — paste a new key to replace it
Admin.stripeNetHint: Based on Stripe's standard {currency} rate. Your actual fee depends on the card type and your account country.
Admin.stripeNetNoPrice: Enter a price to see the estimate.
Admin.ingredientsCostHint: Estimated cost of the ingredients in one dish as served by default.
Admin.noIngredientsCost: Add priced ingredients to see a cost breakdown.
Admin.costMixedCurrencyNote: Some ingredients are priced in another currency; the total is an approximation.
Admin.costEstimateNote: Ingredients without a price or with an incompatible unit are excluded from the total.
Admin.paymentsIntro: Connect your own Stripe account to take payments on this site. Money goes directly to your Stripe account. Both steps below are required: with the keys but no webhook, customers can pay and their orders will never be confirmed.
Admin.paymentsStepKeysHelp: Open the API keys page in your Stripe dashboard and copy both keys into the fields below. A secret key is stored encrypted and is never shown again — leave the field blank to keep the saved one.
Admin.paymentsStepWebhookHelp: In your Stripe dashboard, add a webhook endpoint pointing to the URL below. This is how Stripe tells us a payment succeeded — it is the only thing that marks an order paid.
Admin.paymentsEventsHelp: Subscribe the endpoint to these events, then paste its signing secret below:
Admin.paymentsIncompleteWarning: Payments are switched on but the setup is incomplete. Until both the secret key and the webhook signing secret are saved, checkout stays disabled.
Admin.menuItemsDesc: Meals, dishes and drinks with customizable ingredients and internal recipes
Admin.menuCategoriesDesc: Organize your menu items into categories
Admin.sortRowsHint: Drag the handle to re-arrange the rows, then turn Sort off to save the new order.
Admin.deleteIngredientText: Are you sure you want to remove this ingredient?
Admin.ingredientsHint: Defaults are included in the base price. Set an up-charge for optional add-ons or extras a customer can add.
Admin.recipeHint: Kitchen preparation. Never shown to customers.
Admin.variantsHint: Other items that are alternative versions of this one (a different size, or a vegan or gluten-free version). The link is mutual - it also appears on the other item.
Admin.variantsEmpty: No other items to link yet.
Admin.ingredientsDesc: Reusable ingredients with nutrition, shared across menu items
Admin.nutritionSearchHint: Uses the name, unit and basis above to find nutrition facts online.
Admin.nutritionSearchNone: No nutrition data was found on the web for this ingredient.
Admin.nutritionSearchError: The nutrition lookup failed. Please try again.
Admin.priceSearchHint: Estimates the price from the name, unit, basis and currency above, and finds providers online.
Admin.priceSearchNone: No price or providers were found on the web for this ingredient.
Admin.priceSearchError: The price lookup failed. Please try again.
Admin.priceSearchProvidersFound: {count, plural, one {# provider found} other {# providers found}}
Admin.providersHint: Where this ingredient can be bought — a link and a price. Optional.
Admin.removableHint: On: an add-on the customer adds (up to max). Off: included by default in the base price.
Admin.devTenantMismatchTitle: You are signed in to a different site
Admin.devTenantMismatchText: The dev site switcher is previewing {site}, but your account belongs to another tenant. The CMS always edits the tenant you signed in as, never the previewed one, so anything saved here would land on the wrong customer. Log out and sign in with a {site} admin account.
